facts.fact: La Nation, reporting the UNESCO-supported readiness assessment, says no law specifically addresses artificial intelligence in Djibouti to date, the Code du numerique being a data-protection frame.

DJI.note: No government body's AI use is stated.
Only a nascent AI use in port logistics (Corridor Vision AI) is mentioned, with no public sector system or output stated.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
